description: This file defines the internal class StateMachineManager, which manages durable state machines within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for registering, initializing, recovering, and writing state machines, as well as handling log segments and lifecycle participation. The class implements multiple interfaces for lifecycle and disposal handling, indicating its role in orchestrating state machine lifecycle and persistence.

classes.name: StateMachineManager
classes.description: Manages durable state machines, handles lifecycle participation, persistence, recovery, and log management within Orleans.

classes.name: StateMachineLogWriter
classes.description: Provides methods to append log entries and snapshots to the log segment for a specific state machine.

classes.name: StateMachineManagerState
classes.description: Durable dictionary managing the mapping between state machine names and IDs, with reset capabilities.

classes.name: WorkItem
classes.description: Represents tasks to be processed by the work loop, including initialization, logging, snapshotting, state deletion, and registration.

methods.name: RegisterStateMachine
methods.description: Registers a new state machine by name and enqueues the registration task.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Performs initialization asynchronously, enqueuing the task and signaling the work loop.

methods.name: WorkLoop
methods.description: Main processing loop handling queued work items such as log appends, snapshots, state deletion, and registration.

methods.name: RecoverAsync
methods.description: Recovers state from storage by reading log segments and applying entries to state machines.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Enqueues a request to append logs or create snapshots, managing concurrent writes.

methods.name: OnSetStateMachineId
methods.description: Associates a state machine name with an ID and resets its state machine instance.

methods.name: TryGetStateMachine
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a state machine by name.
